newsitem.title: USA: Terex to repurchase 13.25 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Terex to repurchase 13.25 pct notes.

text.p: Terex Corp said Monday it is offering to repurchase $100 million of its 13.25 percent senior secured notes.
The offer, which is at par plus accrued interest, will remain open until December 27, the company said.
Last week the company said it had completed the sale of its Clark Material Handling business for $139.5 million.
"We have previously stated that we planned to reduce debt with the Clark sale proceeds, and we have wasted no time in taking steps to implement this plan, chief executive Ronald M. DeFeo said.
"We also immediately repaid the entire balance borrowed under our revolving credit facility," DeFeo continued.

"These steps, together with others which we are considering for 1997, should significantly improve Terex's financial position and reduce its interest expense, which has been a major factor affecting our bottom line. We look forward to 1997 as a year which we believe will provide both improved liquidity and profitability."
Terex sold Clark Material Handling Co to CMHC Acquisition Corp, a company formed by Citicorp's Citicorp Venture Capital Ltd and members of Clark's management.
